# openmetadata_chart (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata chart. A chart belongs to a dashboard service and can be attached to one or more dashboards.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_dashboard_service" "looker" {
  name         = "looker"
  service_type = "Looker"
}

resource "openmetadata_chart" "revenue_by_region" {
  name         = "revenue_by_region"
  service      = openmetadata_dashboard_service.looker.fully_qualified_name
  display_name = "Revenue by region"
  description  = "Monthly revenue split by region."
  chart_type   = "Bar"
  source_url   = "https://looker.example.com/charts/42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Chart name. Changing it replaces the chart, because the name is also part of its fully qualified name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the dashboard service that owns the chart. Changing it replaces the chart.

### Optional

- `chart_type` (String) Chart visualization type, for example Bar, Line or Pie.
- `dashboards` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the dashboards the chart is placed on. An empty list detaches the chart from every dashboard.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the chart.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `source_url` (String) URL of the chart in the source BI tool.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. It combines the dashboard service name with the chart name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_chart.revenue_by_region 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which combines the dashboard service name
# with the chart name.
terraform import openmetadata_chart.revenue_by_region looker.revenue_by_region
```
